title: HLSE File Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json file <path>` or the file entries emitted by `hlse_core --json scan <dir>`.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict. Use this field to identify verdicts that predate a new detector capability and should be re-scanned.

path.description: Absolute path to the analysed file (JSON-escaped).

pattern.description: Attack-pattern label (e.g. 'double-extension file masquerade'). Present when score > 0.

verify.description: The single independent check before opening the file (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other assets at risk if the file was opened (score >= 60 only).

blind_spot.description: What HLSE cannot detect for file analysis (score 0 only).

reasons.description: Per-signal detector reasons. Empty array for SAFE verdicts.
